core_meaning.primary_meaning: Fozia is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Victorious, triumphant”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fozia corresponds to the Arabic form فوزية (Arabic root ف و ز (f-w-z)). Its core sense is victorious, triumphant. Fozia is a South Asian spelling of Arabic فوزية (Fawziyya) 'victorious, triumphant', from the root ف و ز. The source gloss 'protector, defender' is wrong (that sense belongs to Arabic حفيظة) and has been replaced. The source's 'Arabic form' Fahzia and the Urdu form فظية are also non-standard and were corrected.

persian.name: فوزیه
persian.long_meaning: Fozia (فوزیه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن پیروز، کامروا است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
